anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
The framing stays as you kept it: the policy is owned by the existing settings resolver (settings/resolver.ts:12) and consumed by the report view (ui/report-view.ts:30). What should the report view do with active filters when the user switches workspace?

A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch, so each workspace opens unfiltered.
B) Preserve all active filters across switches, so the same filters carry into the new workspace.
C) Restore each workspace's last filters, so returning to a workspace brings back what was set there.

Recommendation: B - it matches what the workspace-change handler already does. The policy stays a single resolver value with no new per-workspace filter state, and existing users see no behavior change.
